text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mile races— Winning them demands every 
single ability.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: First and foremost, overwhelming "Speed"!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Speed alone isn't enough to push through— 
you need "stamina" to sustain your 
tenacity!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fast-paced, yet full of developments— and 
the "tactics" to conquer it all!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If you lack even one of them, you can't 
win at the mile. In other words, the one 
who rules the mile is the strongest of 
all!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: All races lead to the mile, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The ringing chime brought me back to my 
senses. Closing the training materials I'd 
been absorbed in, I pack up my things."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's menu, the logged times... and 
don't forget the training materials I was 
reading through.
choice_data_list:
Honestly, there's just never enough 
time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Lamenting won't stop the flow of time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria's debut has been set. All 
that's left now... is to keep running 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: My Rule #12!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
To finish off our roadwork, we do the 
"GIRLS' LEGEND U" pose in the stands!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Phew! Gran-chan, do you always run all 
the way up to the stands?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right! Because it's my rule!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is Loves Only You, the evangelist of 
love.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um, I was wondering where you were headed. 
M-My goal line is the school gate, you 
see...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, warming up all together like this 
is wonderful—it always brings new 
discoveries.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I haven't really had many chances for that 
sort of thing lately, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The racing geek Chrono Genesis, and the 
lovely, noble blossom Curren Bouquetd'or.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's right, everyone's started preparing 
for their debuts in earnest, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My debut's been decided! Tokyo Racecourse, 
and the distance is 1600m, of course!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, congratulations! You're the first 
one among us!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, thanks! So today, after training... 
Ah!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
There's Trainer! Well then everyone, I'll 
be heading out first!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'll win my way through and be waiting for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Oh. 'After you'... so that's what you 
meant. Fufu, I'd better make sure I'm not 
left behind."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Our debut... It's finally starting 
to feel real.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Traaaiiiineeeer! ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I looked up at the calling voice. Over in 
the stands, Gran Alegria was waving her 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She jumped over the railing?! Leaping 
straight into a full flip. And then a half 
twist!
choice_data_list: Is that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She bounced down the spectator stands with 
acrobatics— and like swinging on a 
horizontal bar, ducked under the outer 
rail!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer, good morn-mile!
choice_data_list: Good morn-mile! Was that parkour just now?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I saw it on TV yesterday and got 
curious, so I decided to try it out!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Zigzagging sideways while spinning seemed 
really difficult, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: But look, I managed to do it!
choice_data_list: ...Just from seeing it on TV?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes, seeing it once is usually enough for 
me to get the gist.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Before getting down, I checked to make 
sure nobody was passing by! It was 100 
miles safe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Incredible athletic ability, as always. 
Gran Alegria possesses a natural gift that 
lets her pull off even the most difficult 
moves with ease.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She told me she can tell how it moves 
purely on "instinct."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The same held true for racing—
choice_data_list:
Then it looks like you're plenty warmed 
up.

Then it looks like you're plenty warmed 
up.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm fully warmed up! I finished all 
the warm-up drills too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do our best with training today 
too~!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Pushing down hard gives a stronger kick 
off the ground, so they crouch right at 
the moment of the start.
choice_data_list:
However, sinking down like that causes a 
split-second delay.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why you keep your posture 
low. If you burst out while keeping that 
posture...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've got the picture now! I'll give 
it a shot, so please watch!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So in other words, that's what it means, 
right?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah... Exactly!
Y-yeah... That's exactly right!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it feels like I've gotten 3.3 mph 
faster!
choice_data_list: Does anything feel off to you, Gran?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, 90 miles feels pretty good, but... I 
want to make fine adjustments and find the 
optimal posture!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: And so, I'm going for one more rep!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once I explained the need for identifying 
issues and solutions, she immediately 
understood and applied it to her running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Demonstrating her physical genius, Gran 
Alegria breezed through her training with 
astounding speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I can hardly keep up with 
adjusting the training menu.
choice_data_list: (It's a happy problem to have, though!)
(It's a happy problem to have, though!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that day's training, Gran Alegria 
and I were scheduled to go greet a certain 
person.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, are you okay? You look as 
pale as a sheet...?"
choice_data_list: I-I'm fine... I'm just a little nervous...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But you've met before, right? Don't 
you two talk?
choice_data_list:
Out of the question! That's a huge, huge, 
huge senior, you know!?

Out of the question! That's a huge, huge, 
huge senior, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That person is a grand veteran with a 
career spanning decades. They are not 
someone a newcomer like myself can 
casually speak to.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see. But she was very friendly and easy 
to talk to, even though it was my first 
time meeting her. No need to worry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Yes, my connection with that person all 
began with Gran Alegria.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by the potential of milers he 
advocated, Gran Alegria directly pleaded 
for him to become her trainer. However, 
she was turned down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since they said they hadn't spoken with 
him since, we decided to take this 
opportunity to give a proper report.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, your complexion is looking 
even worse...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If you're worried, would you like me to 
hold your hand?
choice_data_list:
No... sorry, I'll get my head back in the 
game.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Such a pathetic state of affairs is 
unacceptable. As Gran Alegria's trainer, I 
must show her a side of me I can be proud 
of!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you look a bit sharper now. Fufu, well 
then, shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Gran. I heard you had a report for 
me today? Which means... oh, and you are--

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, this is my Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Thank you for your hard work! 
Inexperienced as I may be, I will—

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, of course I know. Tell me, do you 
like sweets?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...And then Trainer showed up, doing the 
exact same routine as my own personal 
rule."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria's debut announcement took 
place during a relaxed tea party. She must 
have set it up to be considerate of how 
nervous I was.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, so delicious♪ Sweet treats and 
tea really warm the soul, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And so, right then and there, I asked 
them. Please become my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! That's way too out of the blue! 
I'm surprised they even took you 
seriously.
choice_data_list:
I was startled, but your eyes... they were 
completely serious...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer listened to my dream, watched me 
run—and made their decision.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
They're someone who chases the same dream 
as me!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Is your dream... conquering three weight 
classes?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Conquer three divisions and become the 
true Mile Queen. That is Gran Alegria's 
goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Conquering three distance categories means 
winning across all three divisions: 
Sprint, Mile, and Medium.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“However, Umamusume have distance 
aptitudes. Determined by the natural 
composition of their muscles, they cannot 
easily be overturned.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, no Umamusume has ever achieved 
this feat. That is how difficult a path it 
is.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I possess natural-born speed. Speed enough 
to win even in sprints.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"A miler Umamusume who possesses both 
speed and the stamina to endure even 
intermediate distances..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"There is potential to transcend even 
distance aptitudes."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's my potential, the very thing you 
showed me!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: True, I still believe so even now, but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'm right here?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
No, you already know the hardships ahead, 
don't you? Because it doesn't come 
easily... that's what makes it a "dream."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Whether it's 0.75 miles or 1.25 
miles, it's all miles, isn't it? So, it's 
not far at all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am Gran Alegria, the Mile 
Genius!"

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! I see... So you share the same 
opinion?
choice_data_list: Yes. With Gran's legs, surely...!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see... Heheh. You've found someone with 
whom you can walk in stride toward the 
same dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
He muttered pensively, appearing 
thoroughly impressed from the bottom of 
his heart.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to us conquering all three 
divisions, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm already looking forward to 
seeing you all shine on the turf.
